notes: This conceptual model represents a comprehensive platform for education and enterprise management. It includes core entities like Users, Organizations, Courses, and Projects, with detailed attributes and complex relationships. Generalization is used for User types (Student, Instructor, Administrator, Employee). Weak entities are identified for Lesson, Material, and Answer. Polymorphic associations for Comments and Attachments are modeled with multiple optional foreign keys to represent the 'target' entity. Many-to-many relationships are resolved using junction entities. Self-referencing relationships are included for Tasks (parent-child) and Messages (threads).
